name: Aşırı Düşünme / Karar Felci
definition: Soru veya fırsat geldiğinde mükemmel cevabı aramak, belirsizliğe tahammül edememek ve eylem başlatmadan önce 3-5 saniye içsel döngüye girmek.
symptoms: Garson örneğinde başkası 1 sn'de konuşurken sen 3-5 sn düşünüyorsun
Ne desem? Doğru mu? Bileyim mi? döngüsü
Sosyal ortamda iç ses konuşurken dışarı ses çıkmıyor

mechanisms.primary: Intolerance of Uncertainty (IU) — belirsizliğe negatif reaksiyon
secondary: Maladaptive safety behaviors in decision making (reassurance seeking, over-research)
Cognitive Attentional Syndrome — repetitive negative thinking (Wells, 2009)
mechanisms.brain: Prefrontal cortex overloaded; dlPFC under-engaged or over-engaged depending on anxiety level

research_sources.finding: Decision paralysis ≠ procrastination. Paralysis = freezing at commitment under ambiguity. Interventions: exposure to uncertainty, good-enough criteria, remove reassurance rituals.
IU causally affects indecisiveness (N=301, pre-registered). Increased IU → more indecisiveness. IU reduction = promising treatment target.

research_sources.authors: Making it Worse by Trying to Make it Better
research_sources.finding: IU associated with maladaptive safety behavior in decision making. Overthinking and seeking too many opinions makes decisions harder.
Implementation intentions bypass deliberation. If-then plans automate goal-directed responses. d=0.65 across 94 studies, 8461 participants.
II increases cue accessibility AND automates response. Two distinct processes: better cue detection + faster response initiation.
80%+ expert decisions: recognize pattern → act. <12% compare options. Experts DON'T think faster — they DON'T NEED to think.
Means-ends analysis during problem solving consumes working memory, leaving little for action. Reducing goal specificity enhances performance.
Exposure to uncertainty: graduated practice committing under ambiguity with bounded stakes and explicit good-enough criteria.
RPD model relies on satisficing — first workable option, not optimal. Speed > perfection in time-critical situations.
When cognitive control is NOT adaptive — over-control can hurt in social contexts with high anxiety.
Observe→Orient→Decide→Act. Over-thinkers stuck in Observe/Orient. Target: compress to Act within 1 second.
Must act within 3 seconds of considering a comment. Prevents second-guessing and conversation moving on.
Don't try to think faster — prevent/manage time pressure. Transfer high-pressure decisions to low-pressure preparation.
In emergencies, people drop to lowest level of training. Aim for 80% solution, not perfection. Perfect is enemy of good.
II effects mediated by cue accessibility and cue-response linkage strength. Planning BEFORE event is key.
Implementation intentions = passing control of behavior to environment. Strategic automation of goal striving.
Social skills often adequate in anxiety — can't ACCESS them under threat. Prefrontal throttled by anxiety.
Assessment-action pairing supports executive function for quick situation sizing and acting. Don't separate assessment from action in training.

solutions.name: Implementation Intentions (If-Then)
solutions.protocol: Her sabah 3 plan: 'X olursa → Y yaparım'. Spesifik durum + spesifik eylem.
solutions.example: Aidat sorulursa → 'Bakıyorum— WhatsApp listesinden kontrol ediyorum'
solutions.time_to_effect: Immediate for planned situations; 2 weeks for habituation

solutions.name: 1 Saniye Kuralı
solutions.protocol: Soru geldiğinde 1 sn içinde ilk sesi çıkar. 'Bakıyorum—' veya 'Evet—' veya 'Bilmiyorum—'
solutions.example: Telefonu al + ağzı aç = aynı anda

solutions.name: Yeterince İyi (Satisficing)
solutions.protocol: Mükemmel cevap arama. İlk işe yarar cevabı uygula. %80 çözüm > %0 çözüm.

solutions.name: Belirsizlik Maruziyeti
solutions.protocol: Günde 1 küçük belirsizlik: bilmeden hareket et, sonra sonucu gör. 'Bakayım' de, cevabı sonra bul.

solutions.name: Hazır Script Ezberleme
solutions.protocol: 5 cümle ezberle: 'Bakıyorum—', 'İlk aklıma gelen şu—', 'Bana 1 saniye ver', 'Kayboldum ne diyordun?', 'Bilmiyorum kontrol edeyim'

solutions.name: Ağız Önce Protokolü
solutions.protocol: Karar vermeden ağzı hareket ettir. Beyin cümleyi tamamlar.

solutions.name: TPM — Zaman Baskısını Önle
solutions.protocol: Yüksek baskı anlarını düşük baskı hazırlığa taşı. Önceden planla, anında uygula.

daily_protocol.evening: Kaç kez düşünme döngüsüne girdin? Kaç kez 1 sn kuralını kullandın? (5 dk)

weekly: Kaç kez 1 sn içinde konuşmaya başladın (hedef: artış)

interactions.note: Bilgi eksikliği düşünmeyi artırır. Düşünme eylemi geciktir. İkisini paralel çöz.
